input.quote: 12.22 Notwithstanding any other provisions in this Paragraph 12, when the Equipped Capacity is expanded to six (6) times of Initial Equipped Capacity or three (3) years after the RFS date whichever comes first, any Party is entitled to make available any of its Allocated Capacity for use by other Carriers on any commercial basis without any restrictions.
input.rationale: We found no exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements-purchasing obligation binding us anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "exclusiv", "sole", purchase/procure covenants, third-party restrictions and non-compete language returned only: (i) p0262, the "sole and exclusive remedy" wording in the dispute-resolution procedure, which is a remedies limitation rather than a sourcing restriction (and is a GOVLAW/remedies point, not an exclusivity point); and (ii) provisions that run in our favour — Paragraphs 12.20 and 12.22 expressly entitle each Party to sell IRUs and make Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "without any restrictions", and Paragraphs 17.2-17.4 require reasonable, non-discriminatory access arrangements and forbid Terminal Parties impeding Direct Access. The Agreement therefore satisfies our preferred position that Customer bear no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation, and no redline is needed.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
